scenes.title: Opening Theme Song
scenes.summary: Opening theme music and credits roll over backstage imagery for Episode 17.

scenes.title: Sneaking Home From the Hospital and Finale Triumph
scenes.summary: After sneaking out of the hospital to his apartment, Chun Yuqiao hides a panicked Bu Xiaogu in the bedroom when Xingtian's chairwoman and the DTS director arrive to celebrate Twelve Singers crushing Supernova and restore his executive post.

scenes.title: Missing-Persons List and Delaying the Broadcast
scenes.summary: Kaiwen and Xingzi report that overseas authorities confirmed the missing-persons list with possible kidnappings, prompting Chun Yuqiao to recommend delaying the new travel show.

scenes.title: The Lead Star Explains the Political Risk to His Missing Twin
scenes.summary: After the executives leave, the travel show's lead star confides to Chun Yuqiao by phone that airing the show could endanger his missing twin brother given their adoptive parents' political background.

scenes.title: Takeout at Home and Learning to Treat Himself Better
scenes.summary: Joining Bu Xiaogu over takeout at Chun Yuqiao's apartment, Kaiwen orders his boss to stay in bed and urges him to treat himself better in both work and love.

scenes.title: The Midnight Ring and Unwavering Devotion
scenes.summary: Kaiwen tells Chun Yuqiao that even when a wealthy suitor brought Bu Xiaogu a ring during finale night, she never left Chun Yuqiao's side because her heart belongs entirely to him.

scenes.title: Xiaogu Is Not Luo Lin
scenes.summary: Speaking from the heart, Kaiwen urges Chun Yuqiao not to hold back out of past trauma over Luo Lin, reminding him that Bu Xiaogu is a completely different person.

scenes.title: His Daughter Turns Out to Be a Cat
scenes.summary: Xingzi leaves Chun Yuqiao in Bu Xiaogu's care and forwards videos of his five-year-old overseas daughter—only for a stunned Bu Xiaogu to discover that she is actually a cat.

scenes.title: Confessing How Long She Has Liked Him
scenes.summary: Overwhelmed with relief after seeing the cat video, Bu Xiaogu blurts out that she has liked Chun Yuqiao for a long time, though he stiffens because she already has a boyfriend.

scenes.title: Sent Away From His Apartment
scenes.summary: Bu Xiaogu tearfully admits that her every mood rises and falls with Chun Yuqiao and that she refuses to lie to herself anymore, prompting him to order her out of his home.

scenes.title: Bu Xiaogu's Breakup and Chun Yuqiao's Restless Dream
scenes.summary: Bu Xiaogu's boyfriend ends their relationship after sensing they belong to different worlds, while Chun Yuqiao dreams of quietly admitting he likes Bu Xiaogu too.
scenes.location: Xingtian cafeteria and Chun Yuqiao's bedroom

scenes.title: Staying Behind Alone With the Master Cut
scenes.summary: After the crew finishes a month of rush editing to deliver the travel show to DTS, Chun Yuqiao sends everyone home, weighs the kidnapping risk, and secretly deletes the master cut.

scenes.title: Uproar Over the Vanished Master Cut
scenes.summary: Panic erupts at Xingtian the next morning when staff discover the finished master cut was deleted overnight and DTS demands an immediate explanation.
scenes.location: Xingtian post-production centre and executive floor

scenes.title: Chun Yuqiao Offers to Resign to Shield Xingtian
scenes.summary: Behind closed doors, Chun Yuqiao explains to the chairwoman why staging an accidental deletion protects her standing with Xingtian's new investor and offers to resign, which she refuses.

scenes.title: Persuading Wang Er and Xie Ling for the Access Password
scenes.summary: Bu Xiaogu corners senior editors Wang Er and Xie Ling, reminding them how they once let her into the archive room off the record to get the post-production door system password.

scenes.title: Altering the Keycard Log and Executive Showdown
scenes.summary: Bu Xiaogu slips into Administration to alter the door log and call the police on herself while the DTS director and Xingtian executives confront Chun Yuqiao.
scenes.location: Administration office and Chun Yuqiao's office

scenes.title: Claiming She Deleted the Master Tape
scenes.summary: Bu Xiaogu bursts in with altered keycard timestamps claiming she deleted the master cut at two in the morning and called the police to turn herself in, earning a sharp rebuke from Chun Yuqiao.

scenes.title: Pushing Her Away to Protect Her Future
scenes.summary: To stop Bu Xiaogu from ruining her career for him, Chun Yuqiao harshly tells her she has no right to take the fall and suspends her until his own resignation is complete.

scenes.title: The Chairwoman Refuses to Betray Loyalty Before the Investor
scenes.summary: Meeting the powerful new investor, Xingtian's chairwoman defends her people-first philosophy and vows never to abandon loyalty to her team.

scenes.title: Chun Yuqiao Declines the Investor's Offer to Poach Him
scenes.summary: Chun Yuqiao turns down the investor's offer to fund a rival company for him, praises Xingtian's chairwoman, and agrees to keep his resignation quiet on one condition.

scenes.title: Quietly Packing Up the Chief Editor's Office
scenes.summary: Having cleared out his office without telling his colleagues, Chun Yuqiao bids a quiet farewell to Xingtian's chairwoman so the company can move forward unburdened.
